description: Backends registered on this cloud-labs server. Users/scripts pick one at connect time; the server does not choose a default communicator from .env.

backends.label: Mock bench (default)
backends.description: In-process teaching simulator — full Twin, scripts, and closed-loop without hardware. Soft session leases unless CLOUDLABS_STRICT_LEASE=1.

backends.label: Real bench (requires lab_automation)
backends.description: Hardware communicator for a physical optical bench. Requires lab_automation on this host. Exclusive lease for mutations.
backends.notes: Marked unavailable at runtime when lab_automation_path is missing on this host.
